title: Knowledge-Engine corpus registry
description: corpus/registry.json: the source of truth for the libraries, skills, kits and tools of a corpus, plus its lifecycle flags. The engine validates the file against this schema whenever it loads or writes it. The authoritative copy ships inside the package (knowledge_engine/core/registry.schema.json); corpus/registry.schema.json is an identical copy kept next to the corpus.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editor completion and validation. Ignored by the engine.

version.description: Registry format version. Always 1; a registry without it is read as version 1.

corpus_root.description: Informational: the corpus directory this registry describes (e.g. 'corpus/'). The engine resolves the corpus root from KE_CORPUS_ROOT / KE_HOME, not from this field.

last_updated.description: Unix time of the last change, written by the engine on every update.

entry.title: Registry entry
entry.description: Fields shared by every entry (the engine's RegistryEntry). Entries may carry additional, fork-specific fields; the engine stores and serves them unchanged.

id.description: Unique id across all buckets, e.g. 'library-demo'. Auto-registered entries use '<kind>-<slugified folder name>'.

kind.description: The entry kind. Optional: the bucket an entry is listed in decides its kind.

path.description: Folder (or single file) holding the entry's content, relative to the corpus root.

enabled.description: Disabled entries are not indexed. Missing means enabled.

auto_registered.description: True when bootstrap or the watcher created the entry.

created.description: Unix time the entry was first written by the engine.

last_updated.description: Unix time the entry was last written by the engine.

indexed_at.description: Informational: when the entry was last indexed.

framework.description: Three-lens framework declared in the library README.

source_library.description: If the skill came from a library, the name of that library.

external_deps.description: Free-text list of external dependencies (e.g. 'Tavily API key').

kind.description: 'tool' (what the engine writes). 'mcp', 'cli' and 'service' are accepted for registries written against the earlier schema, where this field described the tool's transport; the engine reports every entry in this bucket as kind 'tool'.

endpoint.description: URI, command or module path used to invoke the tool.

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle flags
lifecycle.description: Corpus lifecycle flags (GET/PATCH /registry/lifecycle/state). Additional flags are stored and served unchanged.

watch_enabled.description: Watch the corpus for new folders.

auto_register.description: Register new corpus folders automatically (the flag the HTTP API writes).

schedule.description: Cron-like or interval string ('15m', '1h', '24h'); null = no schedule.
